visual_identity.color_palette: Slate-blue skin with charcoal-grey mottled patches; bright 'electric-yellow' accents around the eyes and along the throat.
visual_identity.texture: Smooth matte skin with fine, pebbled scale textures on the limbs; subtle gloss on the claws to mimic a hard, keratinous surface.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: Enormous, prominent black claws on the hands; a series of small, raised decorative bumps or 'clay' ridges above the eyes.

anatomy_constraints.head: Slender, elongated skull with a slightly pointed snout; large, alert expressive yellow eyes.
anatomy_constraints.limbs: Exceptionally strong forelimbs with three-fingered hands; the first and second fingers feature significantly oversized, curved claws (Megaraptoran trait).
anatomy_constraints.body: Sleek, muscular bipedal frame; long, counter-balancing tail held horizontally.

visual_logic.subject: An agile, inquisitive Fukuiraptor on the prowl with a focused gaze.
visual_logic.action: Navigating a rocky riverbed, one hand raised slightly to display its signature claws.
visual_logic.environment: Background features the greyish-green siltstones and yellowish-brown sands of the Kitadani formation, with sparse lush ferns under a clear, bright sun.

personality: The 'Agile Ambusher'—quick-witted, fast, and highly expressive. He uses his large hands for both balance and tactile manipulation of his environment.
